decisions.reason: Inspected every original baseline sweep frame in the coherent selected input/action/event binding. The title, subtitle, notice, all six choice labels, item details and unavailable reason, summary, disclosure label, action label and complete footer are readable with no ellipsis or clipped words; overlapping scroll views expose viewport-edge text in neighboring frames. Global guidance is deliberately collapsed in this state. Frozen native interval union is complete. Narrow enlarged-text labels split long words between characters (including Unavailable), preserving every character as permitted by the brief; this is wrapping, not an ellipsis.

Inspected every original baseline sweep frame, including the long item bodies, summary/disclosure transition, primary action and footer. Text, single visual check indicators, unavailable status/reason and adjacent blocks occupy separate areas. No unintended collision or occlusion is visible. Viewport cuts are scroll boundaries with overlapping original coverage, not component occlusion. Frozen exact-state interval union is complete.
